installer_hotfix.cause: Optional GetOptions /FIXTURE parsing left NSIS's error flag set, so a later IfErrors could report WriteUninstaller failure after a successful write.
installer_hotfix.fix: ClearErrors after optional argument parsing and immediately before WriteUninstaller.
